title: The Beginning of Wisdom

questions.question: What is the fear of the Lord described as in Proverbs 1?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 1:7 (ESV): "The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge; fools despise wisdom and instruction."

questions.question: The proverbs of Solomon are for knowing wisdom and what else?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 1:2 (ESV): "To know wisdom and instruction, to understand words of insight,"

questions.question: What should a son hear from his father?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 1:8 (ESV): "Hear, my son, your father's instruction, and forsake not your mother's teaching,"

questions.question: If sinners entice you, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 1:10 (ESV): "My son, if sinners entice you, do not consent."

questions.question: Where does Wisdom cry aloud?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 1:20 (ESV): "Wisdom cries aloud in the street, in the markets she raises her voice;"

questions.question: What will be a fair garland for your head and pendants for your neck?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 1:8-9 (ESV): "...forsake not your mother's teaching, for they are a fair garland for your head and pendants for your neck."

questions.question: What do the greedy for unjust gain take away?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 1:19 (ESV): "Such are the ways of everyone who is greedy for unjust gain; it takes away the life of its possessors."

questions.question: Because they hated knowledge and did not choose the fear of the Lord, what will they eat?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 1:29-31 (ESV): "Because they hated knowledge... therefore they shall eat the fruit of their way..."

questions.question: Who will dwell secure and be at ease, without dread of disaster?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 1:33 (ESV): "but whoever listens to me will dwell secure and will be at ease, without dread of disaster."

questions.question: How long will the simple ones love being simple?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 1:22 (ESV): "How long, O simple ones, will you love being simple?"

questions.question: What is spread in vain in the sight of any bird?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 1:17 (ESV): "For in vain is a net spread in the sight of any bird,"

questions.question: The complacency of fools will do what to them?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 1:32 (ESV): "and the complacency of fools destroys them;"

questions.question: What did Wisdom say she would do when their terror strikes?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 1:26 (ESV): "I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when terror strikes you,"

questions.question: Those who lie in wait for blood actually ambush whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 1:18 (ESV): "but these men lie in wait for their own blood; they set an ambush for their own lives."

questions.question: What is the purpose of understanding words of insight?
options: To give prudence to the simple
questions.correctAnswer: To give prudence to the simple
questions.explanation: Proverbs 1:4 (ESV): "to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the youth—"

key_verse_text: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge; fools despise wisdom and instruction.
